![](images/profile.JPG){width="220px" fig-alt="Profile photo of Qianzhao Li"}

I am a graduate student at the University of Pennsylvania pursuing a
Master of Applied Economics and Data Science, with an expected graduation
date of 2027. My academic interests center on using quantitative methods to
understand economic questions and turn complex data into clear, useful
insights.

I am especially interested in econometrics, machine learning, and data
analysis. I enjoy combining economic reasoning with computational tools to
study real-world problems. My goal is to continue developing strong research
and analytical skills and apply them in a data-focused career.
